lines.en: Well, I hope you had fun today,
because you're never, ever throwing a party again.
Well, it was just my imagination.
Can I have your attention, please?
I was waiting for the right time to do this,
and I can't think of a better time than right now
with the music playing and all our friends around
thank you for sharing in this joyous moment.
will you please join me on stage?
Okay, then I will come to you, my flower.
will you do me the honor of giving me your tiny hand in marriage?
I've been carrying that ring around in my wallet for six years.
Because you don't know when you're going to meet the right girl,
and the moment's going to be right.
And tonight, with the fireworks, and the music, and everything, it was right.
It's got a nice ring to it.
Hey, you know, I just realized, uh, I don't have a picture of the two of us.
It's digital, so just take as much as you want.
I really thought Jim was going to propose tonight.
